component: PVRTC decoder call-path evidence and bounded source port; static reconstruction only
hash_assumption: Function hashes are SHA-256 over exactly the listed original ELF byte ranges. PT_LOAD mapping is recorded below; file offsets happen to equal VAs for these ranges.
assembly_evidence: reference/pvrtc-call-path.asm: selected exact ARM listings from the identified APK ELF; tool output is LLVM objdump, ARM mode.

functions.scope: Format-pair dispatch; the BL instruction at 0x005f9800 calls the anonymous decompress helper whose entry is 0x005fd894.
Checks source pitch and destination path, dispatches source formats 24-27 to PVRTCDecompress, then may post-convert through engine format 14.
Direct color interpolation helper called twice for each decoded PVRTC block region.
Address mapping helper called for PVRTC block lookups.
Embedded CPU PVRTC decoder. Signature from ELF symbol: (void const*, int mode, int width, int height, unsigned char* output).
Pitch check helper called by anonymous decompress for source and destination dimensions.
PVR header mapping to the engine pixel-format IDs; source scope/case detail also recorded in the parent texture checkpoint.
Generic texture data loop that supplies each source block/level to pixel_format::convert.

trace_evidence.mapping_note: Every function range above lies wholly inside the executable PT_LOAD and was checked before hashing. File offset = p_offset + (VA - p_vaddr), equal to VA here.

limitations: A bounded C++ source port is in decoder/; it is statically cross-checked and not runtime-validated.
No tests or builds were run.
No claim is made that every listed PVR format occurs in a runtime asset or reaches this conversion path.

tables.scope: Engine pixel-format records consulted by pixel_format conversion and by the PVR size model.

range_notes: The pixel_format::convert symbol range is 0x005f95ac..0x005fd894 (end-exclusive), immediately adjacent to the separately named anonymous decompress range 0x005fd894..0x005fda68 (end-exclusive). Hashes are exact to each symbol-declared range.
